chapter: Three Deuces and 52nd Street with Tatum
title: Was the Streets of Paris a segregated club?
summary: The club was mostly white because of its location, but it was not segregated and had a black house band.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Streets of Paris, was it a mostly white club?
Yeah it was white, white. Cause it was way out, and Hollywood, the transportation has never been too good... And we was playing way in the heart of town...
Did black people come to streets of Paris at all?
Yeah, they came, but it was not as much as other types of people...
But it wasn't a segregated club?
No no no. Hell, no. They had a black band there. Big six or something. We were black so it was no segregated thing, no.
Did a lot of musicians come...
